extracted.name: Chickpea, Artichoke, and Feta Salad
extracted.description: Chickpeas, artichokes, and feta cheese combine to create this recipe for a light and refreshing salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
0.5 lemon, juiced, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon chopped fresh mint, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine chickpeas, artichokes, celery, feta cheese, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, mint, oregano, and thyme together in a bowl; toss to coat completely.
